job.job_title: Immediate Hiring-AI/ML-Generative AI Engineer-PAN India-UK Shift
job.job_description:
Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we dont just adapt to changewe drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and were leading the charge. Genpacts AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how were scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team thats shaping the future, this is your moment.




Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.




Responsibilities

Designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and enhancing cloud software for using leading-edge technologies, advanced analytics, GenAI, and Agents for AML in a distributed parallel compute environment
Learning new methods, frameworks and languages to ensure optimal solutions
Configuring and maintaining Hadoop-based platforms for Big Data parallel processes
Using advanced techniques (indexing, caching, estimating, etc.) to improve code efficiency.
Evolving CI/CD pipelines to configure and deploy new capabilities
Working with the Product Owner, teammates, and clients to gather and sequence business and technical requirements
Troubleshooting and resolving complex data and processing issues
Integrating designed data analytics into a larger software ecosystem
Understanding and communicating complex technical solutions in the AML/KYC/EDD domain and evangelizing the riskCanvas solution to clients



Qualifications we seek in you!




Minimum Qualifications



BE/B Tech/M Tech/MCA/BCA
Passion to learn quickly and work independently and as a team
Experience with building systems using AWS, Java, Python or similar technologies
Experience with Big Data and Cloud



Preferred Qualifications/ Skills



Experience demonstrating NoSQL database systems, including HBase or a similar data store
Experience using distributed and parallel computing technologies, including Hadoop, MapReduce, and Spark, to write batch and streaming analytic processing jobs
Experience implementing and demonstrating OpenSearch or a similar indexer
Exemplary technical communications skills
Experience working in an agile environment
Experience with Linux operating systems
Experience with relational databases, including SQL
Experience with exposing query and analytic capabilities as RESTful services
Experience with Python, Scala, R
Experience teaching and leading technical conversations
Familiarity with visualization and user interface technologies
Experience with git and gitflow
Experience with Jira Software and Confluence, or similar tools
Experience in evaluating the cost and security implications of software solutions during the development process.



Why join Genpact?

Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation
Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter
Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities
Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day
Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress



Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.




Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
